# Repository Guidelines

Sources: `ARCHITECTURE.md`, `BACKLOG.md`, `PRODUCT_DESIGN.md`, `PROJECT_LOG.md`, `TESTING_PLAN.md`, and `WORKFLOW.md`.

Keep formulation confirmation, plan approval, and activation separate. Use `Resume When` for parking and `Blocked By` for blocking. Plan statuses are `draft`, `pending`, `confirmed`, `implemented`, and `superseded`.

Commands: `python3 -B scripts/docs_check.py` and `python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_docs_check.py'`.
